name: std::wmemset
intro:
Copies the wide character ch into each of the first count wide characters of the wide character array pointed to by dest.

If overflow occurs, the behavior is undefined.

If count is zero, the function does nothing.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
dest

 -

 pointer to the wide character array to fill


 ch

 -

 fill wide character


 count

 -

 number of wide characters to fill

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function is not locale-sensitive and pays no attention to the values of the wchar_t objects it writes: nulls as well as invalid wide characters are written too.

summary: Copies the wide character ch into each of the first count wide characters of the wide character array pointed to by dest.
